svg.title: Which cloud for which shop
svg.text: Which cloud for which shop? A decision path
Ask the questions in this order. The first "yes" usually decides it; price differences come last because they are the smallest.
Start: new shop, or a replatform?
Skills, landing zone, security reviews and support contracts are
already paid for. A move costs more than any price gap between clouds.
AKS or Container Apps, Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, Front Door.
Azure Hybrid Benefit reuses SQL Server and Windows licences; Entra ID
Cloud Run + Cloud SQL + Firestore: containers without a cluster,
scale to zero overnight, per-request billing. On AWS the same shape
is ECS on Fargate + Aurora Serverless v2 + DynamoDB.
Pub/Sub straight into BigQuery, BigQuery ML and Google's recommendation
and retail search products. The data platform decides; the storefront
can sit next to it on GKE or Cloud Run.
EKS or ECS, Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, OpenSearch, CloudFront.
The widest service catalog and Marketplace, the biggest hiring pool,
and the most third-party commerce integrations built for it first.
